propositions: The ticket-type map is duplicated across Cloud and Datacenter Jira adapters, creating risk of silent divergence in create-path behavior.
No build guard exists to prevent a third copy of the ticket-type map from being introduced, unlike the existing guards for status and priority maps.
The two existing copies are content-identical by value, differing only in literal key order, so unification is behavior-preserving on both deployments.

External test consumer (test_outbound_differ_session_log_exclusion.py:87) reads _LOCAL_TO_JIRA_TYPE as a module attribute on outbound_fields, requiring absolute import binding to preserve resolvability.
The canonical single definition must relocate to adapters/jira_family/value_maps.py following the J2 precedent pattern, with imports under the historical private alias in both adapters.
A new AST-based boundary guard must be added to test_jira_family_boundary_heldout.py to fail the build if a second literal is reintroduced.
